title: Windows Gaming Setup
description: Optimize your Windows 11 installation for maximum gaming performance and minimum latency. This guide covers essential debloating and configuration steps.

steps.title: Optimization Goal
steps.content: The goal of this guide is to reduce background processes, optimize system scheduling for games, and ensure your input latency is as low as possible.

infoBox.title: Goal
infoBox.content: Reduce background processes, optimize system scheduling, and minimize input latency.

steps.title: 1. Debloat Windows
steps.content: Windows 11 comes with many pre-installed applications that consume system resources. Removing them frees up memory and CPU cycles.

infoBox.title: Backup First
infoBox.content: Always create a System Restore point before removing system components.

steps.title: 2. Power Plan Configuration
steps.content:
Ensure your laptop is running in High Performance mode to prevent frequency throttling during gameplay.
1. Open Control Panel.
2. Navigate to Hardware and Sound > Power Options.
3. Select High Performance or Ultimate Performance.

steps.title: 3. Disable Mouse Acceleration
steps.content: Mouse acceleration (Enhanced Pointer Precision) ruins muscle memory in FPS games.

steps.title: 4. Game Mode & Graphics Settings
steps.content:
Windows Game Mode helps prioritize games over background tasks.
  • Go to Settings > Gaming > Game Mode and turn it ON.
  • Go to Settings > System > Display > Graphics.
  • Click 'Change default graphics settings'.
  • Turn ON 'Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling'.

infoBox.title: Restart Required
infoBox.content: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling requires a system restart to take effect.
